entities.name: Short name for network
entities.description: An information element sent by the network containing the abbreviated name of the network that the UE should associate with the MCC and MNC from the last visited tracking area identification.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that sends the Short name for network IE to the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE receives the Short name for network IE and associates it with MCC and MNC from the last visited tracking area identification.

entities.name: MCC and MNC from last visited tracking area identification
entities.description: The MCC (Mobile Country Code) and MNC (Mobile Network Code) contained in the last visited tracking area identification that the UE associates with the network short name.

relations.description: The network sends the Short name for network IE to the UE.
The UE receives and processes the Short name for network IE.
The Short name for network IE establishes an association with the MCC and MNC from the last visited tracking area identification.
